description: This PHP class 'KpiMenuConfigurator' implements 'MenuConfigurator' to configure a menu related to KPI (Key Performance Indicator) within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It uses traits for module screen helper functionality and overrides screen 'searchKpi' through the 'configure' method.

classes.name: KpiMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for KPI management in the Performance module, overriding screens as needed.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the 'configure' method to set the current screen to 'searchKpi' and returns null.
